autonomyRules.description: A new lead or commentary link is published automatically and marked unverified.

A status change, effective date or tier change waits for review; the approver is named on the record.
Removal or supersession waits for review; the superseded version is kept.
Any other change to a published record waits for review.

languageRules.description: Records describe what a source says; they never tell a reader what to do.
No record, screen, export or response states whether anyone is compliant or in breach.
'Required' is reserved for counsel's determination; records use source-describing words instead.
Nothing states what the law requires of a particular client; counsel decides what applies.
An Anticipated record shows its trigger date or status, never a likelihood that it will pass or apply.
